\## Research Areas

-   Causal inference
-   (Bio)Statistics
-   Survival analysis
-   Cancer epidemiology
-   Health equity
-   Mental health research
-   Systematic reviews and evidence synthesis

My research publications span causal inference, epidemiology, cancer research, health-related quality of life, systematic reviews, and evidence synthesis.

For a complete and updated publication record, please visit my [\[Google Scholar profile\]](https://scholar.google.ca/citations?hl=en&user=OgRCmEwAAAAJ&view_op=list_works).

Sheikhi Z, Yarmohammadi H, Soltanipur M, \*\*Mokhtari-Hesari P\*\*, Fahimi S, Montazeri A, Heydarirad G. \*\*Effect of chamomile and olive oils on volume, range of motion, and quality of life in breast cancer-related lymphedema: A randomized controlled trial.\*\* \*Lymphatic Research and Biology\*, 2024.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 2023

Montazeri A, Mohammadi S, \*\*Hesari PM\*\*, Yarmohammadi H, Bahabadi MR, Naghizadeh Moghari F. \*\*Exposure to COVID-19 news on social media and consequent psychological distress and potential behavioral change.\*\* \*Scientific Reports\*, 2023.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 2019

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Mansouri S, \*\*Mokhtari-Hesari P\*\*, Naghavi-al-Hosseini F, Farahmand L, Majidzadeh-A K. \*\*The prognostic value of circulating tumor cells in primary breast cancer prior to systemic therapy: A systematic review.\*\* \*Current Stem Cell Research & Therapy\*, 2019.
